$comment: The What's new sheet shown once after an update (app/whats-new.tsx), and the release notes themselves (constants/releases.ts), one key per line under notes.<version>.
title: What’s new

version.note: Heading for one release's notes; version is "1.0.3".

skipped.note: Beside an older version's heading, when more than one release is shown.

v1_1_1.recurringNext: A recurring payment made from one you just paid no longer thinks the next one is due today. Six months means six months, counted from that payment.
v1_1_1.recurringCadence: Changing how often a recurring payment repeats now moves its next date too, instead of just nodding along.
v1_1_1.recurringLinked: The payment you make a recurring payment from now counts as its first one, so it isn't waited for or put in Pending again. The bank only charged you once.
v1_1_1.tripEnds: A trip ends by itself the day after its last day, so the coffee back home stops being filed under the holiday.
v1_1_1.tagPages: Trips & Events and Archived tags each get a page of their own at the bottom of Settings → Tags: a plane for a trip, a party popper for an event.
v1_1_1.dismissed: A suggested regular payment you dismiss stays dismissed. No more “Show 3 dismissed suggestions” lurking at the bottom like an ex.
v1_1_1.launch: A new launch screen: the Kopiyka К in your theme’s colours, taking a small bow on the way out. Still quick. It doesn’t wait for applause.

v1_1_0.events: Events: a birthday, a wedding or a night out gets its own budget, like a trip, and stays out of your monthly budgets. Settings → Trips & Events.
v1_1_0.transferPairs: When your bank notifies both sides of a transfer between your own accounts, the two become one transfer to check.
v1_1_0.checklist: Insights: a payments checklist that includes your recurring payments.
v1_1_0.transferAccounts: A new transfer asks for both accounts on one screen, From and To, and swaps them in a tap.
v1_1_0.transferAmounts: Both amounts of a transfer can be typed, so a bank's own rate or a fee is kept as it was.
v1_1_0.themes: Switching themes is instant, with stronger contrast and more vivid colours.
v1_1_0.catThemes: Themes named after cats: Pusik (the default), Siri, Tadeusz & Kastuś, and Una. The other editor themes are gone; a phone using one switches to Pusik.
v1_1_0.insightDetails: Tap an insight to see what’s behind it: month by month, the highest and lowest, and where the money came from.
v1_1_0.budgetDetails: Tap a budget to see what it went on and how it did month by month.
v1_1_0.debtPayments: Paying back a debt in parts: pick Debt instead of a category, and the debt counts what has been paid.
v1_1_0.paymentIcons: Recurring payments show the company’s logo, or an icon, emoji or picture you choose.
v1_1_0.search: Search has its own screen and finds by tags, trips, events, debts and more, typos and all.
v1_1_0.tripLimit: A trip or event can go without a limit and just count what was spent, and one added ahead of time starts on its first day.
v1_1_0.suggestions: Suggested regular payments you don’t want can be dismissed for good.
v1_1_0.outside: Payments kept outside a trip's budget are now remembered.
v1_1_0.tripTag: A shop visited on a trip no longer hands the trip's tag to what you buy there later.
v1_1_0.bankNote: A payment logged from your bank’s notification keeps the bank’s words apart from your note: add your own, and the bank’s stay underneath.
v1_1_0.watchPending: On Apple Watch, approve a pending payment, or pick its category first, and delete an entry typed by mistake.
v1_1_0.watchNote: Add a note on Apple Watch by dictation or Scribble, right from the category list.
v1_1_0.watchControl: A Log expense control for Control Center, the Smart Stack and the Action button on Apple Watch.
v1_1_0.listTitles: Entries are titled by your note, with the shop and the bank’s words beneath, and by those when there is no note.
v1_1_0.watchFaster: The watch app opens faster, its keypad follows the screen’s corners, and Double Tap moves you on. It now needs watchOS 26.
v1_1_0.watchBudgetNames: The watch and its budgets show the name you gave a budget, and a debt payment says whose debt it is.

v1_0_3.language: Choose the language in Settings → Language, or let it follow the phone.
v1_0_3.categories: Ready-made categories follow the language until you rename them.
v1_0_3.themes: Eight colour themes, each light and dark, with an app icon to match: Settings → Theme.
